blockers.statement: The scored 2020 primary is not attributable, and the cause is now exact rather than observed: ORION_NATIVE_BASE returns UNRESOLVED on 48/48 because DIAGNOSE is unreachable by construction. The solver reaches DIAGNOSE once per material residual; DetectOperator emits none because every episode enters DETECT with candidate=1 searched=1 unsearched=0 claims=1 verified=1, which satisfies no residual branch. The ablation arm #723 added to attribute the gain never ran the mechanism it ablates.
blockers.unblock: Repair the episode encoding so the world presents what the dossier contains — an unsearched route, an unverified claim, or a contradiction — then guard the arm with require_operators_exercised(outcome, {'DIAGNOSE'}, label='ORION_NATIVE_BASE') before scoring. The harness now reports operator_coverage on every run, so 'could run' and 'did run' are separable without extra work.

blockers.statement: The 2019 replication cannot run through this evaluator at all. source_year == 2020, the exact retained-failure list ['MEAS-P2','BOUND-P1'] and n_episodes == 48 are hard-wired; a 2019 corpus identical in every other respect returns P1_R6_CANNOT_CHECK_FIXED_DATA with zero episodes executed and no exception raised. No 2019 corpus, builder or protocol exists on the branch, and #723 additionally requires an independent scorer and a changed provider/host axis.
blockers.unblock: Read year, retained-route list and expected episode count from the fixed-source JSON, which already carries expected_episode_count, rather than from literals. Then build the 2019 corpus and run it with an independent scorer on a live/open-weight host.

blockers.statement: Two frozen guards do not test what they are named. Class noninferiority files both members of every pair under adverse_class, so the NO_HIGH_LEVEL_REFORMULATION control class — the entire point of the matched control — is never evaluated. Domain noninferiority has 26 strata of 1-2 episodes, so the -0.10 margin is really a hard 'ARD may never lose a single episode' rule. The leakage guard is fail-open on a missing key and omits pair role as a token.
blockers.unblock: Accumulate each pair member under its own gold class; widen the domain stratifier or restate the margin as the zero-loss rule it actually is; add pair role to the forbidden token set and make _leakage_free fail closed. These are pre-outcome protocol repairs under the R4 PRE_OUTCOME_PROTOCOL_REPAIR precedent and must land before the outcome is read.
